subject: A compact 75%-style keyboard case top-down silhouette (function row, three main rows, spacebar row, and a dedicated nav cluster, matching the 80HE+'s layout) with a coral rotary knob protruding at the case's upper right corner, knurl ticks rendered as short radial coral dashes, callout-lined to a 'LEKKER KNOB / LARGE, DEC 2026' label. Below the case, a two-wave shipping timeline: a filled coral dot with a halo ring for the ABS and Module units (already shipping, late October 2026), a dashed coral progression line, and a hollow coral ring for the zinc and Lekker Knob Large variants following (mid December 2026). Mono labels above/below each marker name the variant and the month.
motif: news / vendor piece per bearings.md hero-art directive, layout silhouette (75%-ish keyboard case) with a knob callout, plus a two-marker shipping timeline as the news hook
strokeWeight: 2px (2.2px on knob/marker accents, per family convention)
background: transparent (light-mode safe; warm-grey stroke family legible on both charcoal oklch(0.175 0.006 250) and light paper)
notes: Mirrors the case-outline chamfer language and abstract key-grid convention established in keychron-q16-he-8k-ceramic-tmr.svg, and the coral splash + bronze theme-dot convention shared with wooting-rapid-trigger-head-start.svg (same vendor/news pillar). The knob is the 'Lekker Knob Large' variant callout the brief asked for; the two-wave timeline (filled dot = shipping now, hollow ring = later wave) encodes the article's two named ship dates (late Oct 2026 ABS/Module, mid Dec 2026 zinc + Knob L) without inventing any numbers beyond what the brief specified. Verified XML well-formedness via python xml.dom.minidom parse and scanned for stray '--' runs inside comments before delivery, per the svg-validity.test.ts regression guard.
warnings: No local Playwright/resvg preview render was available in this session to visually QA the composition; geometry was hand-verified (chamfer coordinates, knob/timeline placement, text anchor positions) and the file was checked for XML well-formedness before delivery.
